name: Charter Attestation Decoder
description: Decodes the charter payload of a Base EAS attestation from its raw data: version, date, the text names, their sha256 digests and their IPFS CIDs. Deterministic, no network read, so a buyer can check every answer against the chain and the files themselves.

capabilities.description: Decode an EAS charter attestation payload into its named texts and digests.

data_hex.description: the attestation data field, hex encoded

five_laws.law_1_no_harm: It only decodes data the caller already holds; it reads nothing on its own.
five_laws.law_2_no_deception: The answer is a pure function of the request, and a refusal says why.
five_laws.law_3_no_waste: One call, one decode, no retries and no side effects.
five_laws.law_4_no_capture: No account, no key, no lock in: the same code is public in this repository.
five_laws.law_5_no_claim_beyond_evidence: It reports what the bytes contain, never whether a charter is legitimate.
